description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. The page files are written by hand. event-pages holds 00.json, a complete page 0 for blocks 0 to 99 with one open, and .01.json, a second copy of page 0 with one more open, saved under a name that starts with a dot. Every entry in event-pages must be a page file, a regular file named *.json that does not start with a dot (clause 15), so the dotfile refuses the whole census: it may be a page that was meant to count. Read as a page, it would have added an open and a duplicate. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
